Some years ago I had a horrible nightmare, and something even more frightening after waking up.

I smoke weed on a regular basis, and it make me so I either don't have dreams or just can't remember dreaming at all. Well I had been dry for about a week, no money for it.. 2008 was a disaster for me financially.. So I guess I was on an involuntary tolerance break. I was asleep, and entered a dream state..

It was me at home doing nothing in particular. In my dream, I picked up my cat Pooper, and was carrying him around the house cradled like a baby. Singing to him and dancing around the room. Something inside my head cracked, audibly, very loud. I heard crazy voices screaming at me, cursing, hateful, evil: "KILL THE CAT, DO IT, NOW DO IT" I couldn't think straight, and began lightly bouncing the cats head on the corner of the counter top. Three time kinda light but hard enough for him to freak-out and start reacting. He sank his claws in me and in pain I started scream along with the voices. Then started slamming his head, hard as fuck on the counter top. Blood was flying everywhere, all over me, the counter, the floor. It was a disgusting mess. The voices, now cheering started telling me to do the same to myself.

As I plunged my face toward the counter top I woke up covered in sweat, crying like I hadn't cried since I was a child. (48 years old now, was about 36-37ish when this happened) Pooper was standing on my nightstand at the foot of my bed, staring at with this unbelievable look on his face. He somehow knew what I had just experience. I could literally feel and see the fear in his face. I tried to reach out for him, and he fucking want bat shit crazy, hissing and ran like hell from me, out of the room. That's when I noticed some very weird shit going on around me.

Everything in the room, everything, was like a cardboard cutout of itself, a picture, propped in front of me with "little human beings" standing behind them, holding the cutouts up, and laughing at me. If I tried to peer around it to see "them", the cutout would pivot, kind of like.. Minecraft grass, digital, artificial or something, very strange. I couldn't hear the laughter, but I knew it was going on. I could however see them, only for a split second as they ducked back behind the objects. Also I "felt" them watching me, from behind the cutouts, everywhere around the room, when I looked at my cardboard cutout of a laptop on the desktop, behind me they were watching and laugh, and poking their head out to get a glimpse of me. I would spin around to catch them, only to see a cutout of the laundry basket, the space heater, the dufflebag, being propped up by them, while they rotated it around, again like the "Minecraft grass effect" as I tried to peer to the left and right of it to catch them. It was like that scene in the movie "The Skeleton Key" where the witch was hidden behind the mirror. As I examined the basket, I could "feel" the ones behind the laptop behind me peer out and laugh at me, silently. This went on for at least 2 hours, with me running around the house frantically trying to catch "them". It was like an acid flashback or something. Eventually it subsided.

Scared the living fuck out of me. The next day I went to my family physician, and tried to explain it to him. He immediately sent me to a psychologist in the same building. She sat with me for about an hour or more, while I tried again to explain what had happened. She eventually came to the conclusion that what I had experienced was a "cognitive dissonance episode for lack of better words" and tried to send me to some specialist, which I never followed up on, because she told me that meds and more counseling would likely be required. I vehemently despise the whole "head doctor" profession, because all they wanna do is cram pills down your damn throat.

It pretty much ends there, except for now, every so often I have flashbacks I guess you can call it, where I will be driving down the road, or sitting on the couch or whatever, nothing in particular, and will see something out of the corner of my eye, another cardboard cutout. Until I focus on it and realize that it's not really what I thought, I am just seeing shit again. Nothing like that time I could actually "feel them" and witness the objects rotate in the manner they did that day.

So today I was watch a live stream on the old YouTube, and they were talking about DMT and whatnot. Someone brought up a story which reminded me of my episode, and another guy jokingly told him: "You got Charles Bonnet Syndrome". I was intrigued and looked it up. Admittedly I don't have eye problems, borderline blindness and the like described on the wiki, but I am almost sure this is what I had and continue to experience.
